name: Lowlight
description: A Mirran camp beneath the Facade where the Resistance's assault teams gather.

timeline.summary: The group leaps into the lacuna to descend toward the Furnace Layer.
timeline.quote: Nahiri leapt without hesitation, and Kaito jumped after her.

timeline.summary: The Wanderer returns to the razed camp too late and finds her companions gone.
timeline.quote: She had returned from the Blind Eternities too late, and they were lost.
